content:
kim (CEO): Quick exec weekly — condensed. TL;DR: EU private beta greenlit. Two immediate operational asks: tighten default data-retention for Private, and hit p95 latency targets for Dedicated in EU. Cost target: -7% unit cost by next quarter.

samir_vp_ops: Congrats team. Ops will run a capacity and cert check today. Priya, can you get a latency drill-down by model and shard by EOD?

priya_eng: On it. Pushing a perf dashboard update and a short runbook. Expect p95 breakdown for text-gen + embeddings by 16:00 UTC.

michael_fin: Finance updated the cost model — hitting -7% needs a mix of quantization, smarter routing, and reserved pooling. Sharing sims: https://redwood.internal/finance/q2-cost-sims

kim (CEO): Policy note: Legal & Security approved new default retention = 30 days for customer logs in Private unless customer opts in for longer retention under contract. This policy goes live next Tue. @ops-bot will publish rollout plan and flags.

ops-bot: Automated message: "Retention policy change scheduled: next_tues_release; config flags: retention.default_days=30" Please react with :thumbsup: to acknowledge.

samir_vp_ops: Action items for Ops/Infra: (a) Canary retention change in eu-west-1, (b) Add alert for anomalous KV cache-miss spikes after rollout, (c) Confirm fallback model mapping for each region is in place and tested.

priya_eng: Canary config I'm preparing:
```
canary:
  region: eu-west-1
  sample_rate: 0.01
  fallback_models: ["gptx-mini-8q", "redwood-1b-8q"]
```
I'll open a PR to infra repo and attach the perf test matrix.

alex_support: Heads-up from CS: a couple enterprise customers already asked about longer retention for audits. Legal confirmed we can offer custom retention under contract; Sales/CS to coordinate the terms.

michael_fin: Also tracking revenue motion tied to Dedicated seats — target +12% ARR from Dedicated by EOY if adoption holds. We'll align incentives with Sales next week.

kim (CEO): Priority hierarchy this week:
- Blockers: EU network egress certificate rotation (Samir)
- Launch: EU Private beta go/no-go checklist (Priya + Samir)
- Metrics: reduce median inference cost and meet p95 latency SLA (Eng)
- Policy: retention default rollout + enterprise exception flow (Legal/Sales)
Please include owners in PRs and post summaries in #eng-status by EOD Friday.

samir_vp_ops: Adding a scheduled incident review: Thu 10:00 PT for the recent ~2hr degrade — bring logs, span traces, and any replay artifacts.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-334 — https://re/internal/incidents/INC-2026-334

jenna_hr: Reminder — leadership all-hands Friday 11:00 PT. Send deck to Comms by Thursday COB.

kim (CEO): Two asks before Monday: 1) Priya, one-pager on rollout risks & mitigations; 2) Samir, confirm fallback mapping fully tested across EU shards. I'll brief the Board on Monday and want a clean status. :rocket:

priya_eng: Will send the one-pager and link to the perf artifacts by 18:00 PT.

samir_vp_ops: Confirmed — test matrix is in PR #4829, summary posted to the infra PR.

alex_support: Acknowledged. I'll prepare the customer comms template for the retention change and coordinate sign-off with Legal.

kim (CEO): Thanks. Small follow-up: if any team identifies >2% end-to-end latency regression after canary, pause rollout and escalate.

end of thread."
